ICS 83.160; 53.060.01TXD 38Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis Standard (Part 8) prescribes a method for determination of thickness (gauge) of man-made fibre tyre cords taken from cheeses, cones, bobbins, spools, or tyre cord fabrics.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed as in Annex A.
